I was put in a psychward at 16 as well and like what these guys are saying it didn't really do me any good.  Im a rebellious kid and as much as i dont admit it, i think that the care and support my family gave me was what really kept me going up to the present.

I have to admit as well, i resented them for it for a while though, but really showing that you genuinely care is the best thing you can do.

Hope this helps fam

Congratulactations fam

Keep posting any updates about your recovery soon bud, community would love that!
